    def test_write_usage_no_split_on_hyphen():
        """Hyphenated option names are not split at hyphens in write_usage.
    
        Regression for https://github.com/pallets/click/issues/3362.
    
        With break_on_hyphens=True (the bug), textwrap treats each ``\\w-\\w``
        sequence as a valid line-break point.  When padding fills the first
        line to where '--max-retry-' (12 chars) fits but '--max-retry-count'
        (17 chars) does not, the option name is split as '--max-retry-' / 'count VALUE'.
    
        The fix passes break_on_hyphens=False to wrap_text inside write_usage
        so the full token '--max-retry-count' wraps as a unit to the next line.
    
        Overflow policy: when the option token is longer than the available column
        (after the continuation indent), character-level breaking still occurs
        because there is no space to fit the whole token.  The fix only prevents
        the hyphen-logic split; it does not override the overflow fallback.
